transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess I'm just here because... well, for a long time now, I just wake up feeling low. It's like this heavy, gray feeling is already there before I even get to work at the clinic. And it just kind of... stays with me. The whole day.
How long have you been waking up with this low, heavy feeling?

Uh... a while. Over two years. Maybe two years and two months, I guess. It kind of started when the staffing changed at my clinic... they started rotating my schedule all over the place. So, yeah. Since then.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like before this low feeling started?
I don't know. I guess... I haven't really thought about it. I don't really do much besides work anyway. So... yeah, I'm not sure.
Do you still enjoy the things you do at work or outside of work as much as you used to?
I mean... work is just work, I guess. I just go in and do what I have to do. Outside of work, I don't really do much. So... it's hard to say.
Are there things that you used to find pleasurable, but no longer enjoy?
Uh... not really. I mean, I can't think of anything specific. Like I said, I just don't have a lot going on. I just kind of go to work and go home. So... I don't know.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in activities that you used to find enjoyable?

I mean... isn't that kind of what you just asked? I really don't know. Like I said, I don't really have hobbies or anything. I just... I haven't noticed losing interest because I don't really do anything anyway.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure?
I don't... I mean, I guess not? I'm not really sure what you mean by that. I just feel kind of... flat, I guess. Like nothing really matters. So... maybe? I don't know.
Can you think of anything that you find pleasurable or that you look forward to?
No... not really. I just kind of wake up and get through the day. There's nothing I'm really waiting for, I guess.
Do you often feel nervous or on edge?
No... I don't think so. I don't really get nervous. I just... I don't know, I'm just kind of here. So, no.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight since you started feeling this way?
No... I don't think so. I haven't really been paying attention to it, to be honest. I guess it's just stayed about the same.
Do you often feel guilty about things?
No, not really. I mean, I don't... I don't really do much to feel guilty about, I guess. So no, not really.
Have you ever thought about ending your life?
No. I haven't.
Do you feel like you're moving slower or faster than you used to?
Um... no. I don't think so. I haven't really noticed anything like that. Just... normal, I guess.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep patterns since you started feeling this low, heavy feeling?
Um... no, not really. My sleep is pretty much the same, I think. I haven't really noticed a difference.
Do you feel like you're resting or sitting still more often than you used to?
I don't think so. I mean... I sit when I'm tired, but... no more than usual, I guess. Just the same.
Have you had periods of at least two months where you didn't feel this low, heavy feeling since it started over two years ago?
Um... no. Not that I can remember. It's just... always kind of been there, I guess. I don't think it ever really went away for that long.
Do you feel like you're having trouble concentrating or making decisions?

Um... yeah, I guess. Just... at work, mostly. Sometimes I'll just be staring at a patient's intake screen and... I have to reread the same line over and over. And I've caught myself missing little details, I guess. Like medication doses... or just mixing up what I was about to ask them next. So... yeah.
Do you feel like you're fidgeting or restless more often than you used to?
Um... no. Not really. I just... I don't think I'm any more restless than I used to be. It's just normal, I guess.
Do you feel like you're moving slower than you used to, in your daily activities?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think I'm moving any slower. Just... normal, I guess. I haven't really noticed anything like that.
Have you ever had thoughts of harming yourself?
No. Um... I don't... no, I haven't had thoughts like that.
